Summarise logical problems in card dates

Source: R/quality_params.R
date_quality_summary.Rd

Counts, over every dated card dose, the problems VCQI's data-quality report lists: a date before the earliest possible vaccination date for the age window, a date after the interview, doses of a series out of order, the same date on two doses of a series, and a dated later dose with an undated earlier dose. A dose can have more than one problem; the last row counts distinct affected dates.

date_quality_summary(
  x,
  min_age_months = 12,
  max_age_months = 23,
  schedule = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

min_age_months

Youngest eligible age; sets the earliest possible vaccination date as interview_date - (max_age_months + 1) * 30.4375.

max_age_months

Oldest eligible age.

schedule

A vcs_schedule().

Value

A tibble with problem, n_dates, prop_of_dates, and the attribute n_dates_total.

Examples

date_quality_summary(vcs_example)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   problem                                                  n_dates prop_of_dates
#>   <chr>                                                      <int>         <dbl>
#> 1 Vaccination date is before the earliest possible vaccin…      54       0.0465 
#> 2 Vaccination date is after the date of the interview            3       0.00258
#> 3 Vaccination dates in a dose series are out of order            8       0.00689
#> 4 The same date is given for two or more doses in a dose …       4       0.00345
#> 5 Date present for a later dose in a series but missing f…      66       0.0568 
#> 6 Total dates with at least one problem (to be replaced w…     135       0.116
